primary_authority.title: In Re: Assent, Withholding or Reservation of Bills by the Governor and the President of India

holdings_used: Article 200 presents three constitutional options: assent; reserve; or withhold and return with comments for a non-Money Bill.
The opinion states that the Governor exercises discretion in choosing among Article 200 options and is not bound by ministerial aid and advice for that function.
Merits review of the chosen Article 200 option is unavailable, but limited mandamus may issue for prolonged, unexplained and indefinite inaction.
The Court declined judicially prescribed general timelines and deemed-assent substitution.
production_effect: GBK pages334-336 remain exact source text when eventually recovered/certified; no silent correction inside source.
Teaching and scoring must use the later 2025 INSC 1333 position rather than treating the book's earlier 2025 litigation summary as current law.
GroupI answer should distinguish non-justiciability of merits from limited review of prolonged inaction and should not claim fixed judicial deadlines.
